description.value: The Greek Kouzina Express is a family-run Greek restaurant and food truck in Kamloops's Westsyde neighbourhood, operated by third-generation restauranteur Andreas Mougholias whose family has run Greek and Italian eateries in the area since 1975. The menu centres on souvlaki wraps, traditional Greek plates, and shareable sides made from house recipes and fresh ingredients. In addition to the brick-and-mortar dine-in location, they operate a mobile food truck that appears at various community events around the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active restaurant and food truck operation at 2992 Westsyde Rd, Kamloops, BC V2B 7E9, matching the OSM address. The phone number 778-362-1900 is confirmed on the website. Takeout, dine-in, and delivery are all explicitly mentioned; vegetarian and gluten-aware options are listed in the catering section. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill is present in the website content.
